title: Creative Studioで静止画を先に生成し、その画像をSeedance 2.0 Miniに読み込んで画像→動画化する
content:
Creative Studioで静止画を先に生成し、その画像をSeedance 2.0 Miniに読み込んで画像→動画化する  
9:16の縦長アスペクト比でも生成してカメラワークの変化を比較する
tips:

en.content:
Generate a still image first in Creative Studio, then import that image into Seedance 2.0 Mini to convert it from image to video.  
Also generate using a 9:16 vertical aspect ratio to compare changes in camera work.

--- THREAD CONTINUATION ---
[Thread 1] https://t.co/yKWkSnUKS9

[Thread 2] ✨Bonus✨
I tried generating with a 9:16 aspect ratio as well! The camera work changed a bit, and I like this one too 😊 https://t.co/9suS0aoQrX
